nameOrigin: without limit, now it's able to fly

pokedexEntries.rb: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

pokedexEntries.ye: Its wings, covered with poisonous powders, repel water. This allows it to fly in the rain.

pokedexEntries.go: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.

pokedexEntries.si: Water-repellent powder on its wings enables it to collect honey, even in the heaviest of rains.

pokedexEntries.cr: It flits from flower to flower, collecting honey. It can even identify distant flowers in bloom.

pokedexEntries.rs: BUTTERFREE has a superior ability to search for delicious honey from flowers. It can even search out, extract, and carry honey from flowers that are blooming over six miles from its nest.

pokedexEntries.fr: The wings are protected by rain-repellent dust. As a result, this POKéMON can fly about even in rain.

pokedexEntries.lg: In battle, it flaps its wings at great speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

pokedexEntries.em: It has a superior ability to search for delicious honey from flowers. It can seek, extract, and carry honey from flowers blooming over six miles away.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.

pokedexEntries.su: Close examination of its large eyes reveals that each eye is composed of a myriad of tiny eyes.

pokedexEntries.mo: When attacked by other Pokémon, it defends itself by scattering its poisonous scales and fluttering its wings.

pokedexEntries.us: Its wings are covered in toxic scales. If it finds bird Pokémon going after Caterpie, Butterfree sprinkles its scales on them to drive them off.

pokedexEntries.um: Nectar from pretty flowers is its favorite food. In fields of flowers, it has heated battles with Cutiefly for territory.
